description: This file contains unit tests for the EmployeeMembershipService class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing methods like getEmployeeMembershipById, saveEmployeeMembership, deleteEmployeeMemberships, and searchEmployeeMembership within the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeMembershipService, testing various CRUD and search operations on employee memberships.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeMembershipService instance and populates test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Tests retrieving an employee membership by its ID, mocking the DAO layer.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee membership, verifying the returned object matches the input data.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Tests deleting multiple employee memberships by calling DAO delete method and verifying number of rows affected.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Tests searching for employee memberships based on filter parameters, verifying list size and object types.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of employee memberships matching search criteria.
